Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game! However, cricketing action today does not stop as there is still a game left. Canada will be taking on Nigeria. Do join us for all the action from that game. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Man of the Match, Rameez Shahzad, says he was thinking about the last two times he missed his half tons by a close margin but was sure he would get it this time. Says his dad, who played in the 1996 World Cup would surely be watching this match. Further adds that they were confident and looked to attack from the start with the bat.

To be honest the victory was set up by the UAE bowlers. They bowled brilliantly throughout. Mustafa and Waheed were the stars for them and in the end, their batters did the job by chasing this down easily.

Easy-peasy! The UAE side has chased this total down without breaking a sweat. Yes, they lost Mustafa early but Suri and Shahzad, got their eye in and once they did that, they scored at will. The two added 93 for the second wicket with Shahzad scoring a fifty. He did fall shortly after that but Suri remained unbeaten six short of it and took his side over the line.
FOUR! VICTORY FOR UAE! Suri has completed the job for the hosts! Full length ball outside off, Suri takes the aerial route and lofts it over the cover fielder for a boundary. UAE win by 8 wickets.
Length ball outside off, Ahmed looks to play at it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Suri opens the face of his bat to this length ball and guides it towards third man for one.
Waheed Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shahzad has thrown his wicket away but only after taking the hosts to the brink of victory. Short of a length ball outside off, Shahzad looks to pull it towards the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. He does not get the timing on it to clear the fence and the fielder, Raag Kapur in the deep takes a simple catch. He could have finished the game for UAE but he has to walk back after a very good innings.
FOUR! Full ball wide outside off, Shahzad slaps this one through the cover region and the ball races to the fence. 4 runs needed to win now.
Short delivery outside off, Shahzad pulls this one but straight to the man.

FOUR! Delicate! What a shot to bring up your fifty! Length ball just outside off, Shahzad opens the face of his bat and help it fine towards third man. The ball races to the fence. First T20I half ton for Shahzad!
Kyle Christie is back into the attack. He is the only wicket taker till now.
Suri pushes this one back towards the bowler.

Two byes! Floated on off, Chirag looks to push at it but the ball spins in and  he misses the line of the delivery. The keeper fails to collect it and the ball rolls towards fine leg as the batters take two byes.
Floated on the pads, Suri looks to paddle it towards the leg side but it comes off the inner half onto the pads and then it roll towards fine leg.
Suri pushes this floated one on off towards mid off.
On the pads, tucked towards the man at mid-wicket.
Floated on the off pole, Suri reverse sweeps it towards backward square leg and takes a couple.
FOUR! Edgy one! 18 from the over. 100 is up too. Width on offer again, Shahzad throws his bat at it. The ball finds the outside edge and goes down to the third man fence.
Length and on off, Shahzad strokes it firmly to the man at mid off.
WIDE! Short and a little too wide outside off, the batter throws his bat at it but misses.
SIX! That is colossal! Just the 21 needed now. Shahzad comes down the track and Aizaz bowls it short. Shahzad hammers it over the mid-wicket fence for another biggie.
Almost! A yorker outside off, Shahzad makes room and then looks to jam it out but gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Now looks to play the paddle sweep but it goes off the bottom edge towards square leg for one.
SIX! UAE on the charge now! Slightly shorter and on off, the length is picked early. It is pulled over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Aizaz Khan is back on!
A dot to end! Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
A couple now! Very full and on middle, this is hit down powerfully towards long on for two.
On middle, Shahzad goes back and guides it to point.
SIX! That is huge! Another short one, it is the googly. Shahzad picks it, he goes back and pulls it hard over the mid-wicket fence. It goes a long way back. Shahzad wants to end it quickly now.
FOUR! 42 needed now! Short and outside off, Shahzad reaches out for it, cuts it, gets it past point and the ball races to the fence.
The googly on middle, it spins back in. Shahzad does not pick it but in the end defends it out.

Well fielded in the end! Shorter and on middle, Shahzad flat-bats it down towards long on. The fielder there almost overruns the ball. He though sticks his hand out to his right and stops it. Single taken.
A loopy dipping full toss on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Very full and on the pads, this is whipped through mid-wicket for one.
Another good drive! Fuller and outside off, this is creamed wide of long off for two.
This is angled into the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
FOUR! Misfield! Not something you can afford while defending such a low score. Full and on off, this is driven towards mid off where the fielder runs to his right and dives over the ball.
Raag Kapur is on now!
A single to end as this is hit down to long on for one.
Shahzad makes room, the bowler gives it air. Shahzad hits it hard towards long off for one.
Loopy ball on off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Suri shuffles across and the bowler bowls it very full. It is worked to mid-wicket.

Close shave! On middle, Shahzad defends it on the leg side and sets off. The bowler runs towards the ball and then as he slides, picks it up and has a shy at this end but misses. Would have been close had he hit.
On off, Suri works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
Waqas Barkat is into the attack.
FOUR! All the pressure released there! Poor ball. Short and wide outside off, Shahzad slaps it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed back to the bowler.
A couple! Short and on middle, this is pulled towards fine leg. The fielder there runs to his left, slides and then parries it to the fielder running to his right from deep square leg. Two taken.
On middle, this is defended onto the ground. Quite a few dots in the last few overs. 67 needed in 69.
Safe again! It is just not going Hong Kong's way. One more short one from Arshad. Suri looks to pull but gets another top edge. It once again lands safe in the square leg region. One run taken.
Very full and on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
It remains that way as Khan bowls another dot. On middle, it is once again worked on the leg side for no runs.
Just the one run from the over so far as there is another dot. On middle, it is worked to square leg.
Fired this one on off, Shahzad gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
A little too full this time and it is eased down to long on for one.
One more dot as this is worked to the man at mid-wicket.
This is on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Ehsan Khan is back into the attack!
A slower one outside off, it is left alone.
Down the leg side, it has been wided.
One more delivery on a length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
One more short one, Shahzad this time plays a controlled pull shot down to fine leg for one.
In the air... safe! Slightly shorter and on middle, the ball sticks in the surface. Suri looks to pull but gets a top edge. It lands well short of the deep square leg fielder for one.
One more length ball on off, this is kept out.
A low full toss to begin with. It is driven back towards the bowler who leaps and stops it with one hand. Not cleanly but no runs conceded.
Haroon Arshad is on now!
One more ball on a length and on off, Shahzad strokes it to mid off.
Closer to the off pole this time, this is guided to point.
FOUR! Hammered! Width on offer and Shahzad puts it away. It is slightly shorter, Shahzad slaps it through cover-point and bags a boundary.
One more good length ball around off, Suri opens the face of the bat, plays it down towards third man and takes one.
Another length ball on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
This is on middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
Aizaz Khan is back!
SIX! High and handsome! Shahzad gets hold of this one. He makes room by staying leg side of this delivery, jumps down to the pitch of the ball and rockets it over long on. 13 from the over!
Shortish and on middle, Shahzad tries to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A long hop on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Fine shot! Good awareness of the field! Flighted delivery, landing full around off, Suri goes down and across before slogging it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Shortish again, around off, Suri moves across the stumps and pulls it over mid-wicket. It's stopped well near the fence and the batsmen take a brace.
A flatter delivery, on the shorter side around leg, Suri gets back and helps it back in the direction of mid-wicket.
Kinchit Shah to bowl.

FOUR LEG BYES! A poor ball to end! Spoils the over somewhat. Once again the bowler starts off a little too straight, it tails back in more. Shahzad looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad. It goes down to the fine leg fence.
Some swing there but the line is a little too straight. This starts on middle and it comes back in. Shahzad looks to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
A short one on middle to welcome the new batter, Shahzad ducks under it.
Rameez Shahzad is the new batsman.

OUT! In the air... taken! The dasher, Mustafa is out of here. Early wicket for Hong Kong. Just what they would have wanted. That is a good catch by Ehsan Khan. Christie bowls this on the leg pole. Mustafa looks to flick but is a touch early in the stroke. A leading edge is induced. It goes high up in the air behind cover-point. Khan there does not look comfortable under it. He though keeps his eyes on it, takes and then falls forward. A good catch in the end and one he needed to hang onto.
Another delivery on the pads, Suri works it to square leg and crosses.
This one is on the pads and quietly worked behind square leg for a couple of runs.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, Suri tries flicking but misses.
This is full and on off, Mustafa strokes it to covers. Another decent over for Hong Kong.
The batter makes room and the bowler follows him. Suri pushes it past the bowler and towards mid on for one.
On middle, Suri works it to the man at mid-wicket.
On middle, this is defended on the off side for one.
Shorter and on the stumps, Rohan makes room and cuts it to point.
Flatter and on middle, this is kept out.
Ehsan Khan is on now!
Good length and on off, Suri defends it onto the ground. A good over by Khan first up.
Outside off, this is left alone.
On off, the batter drops it towards cover for one.
On the pads, the batter tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
WIDE! Down the leg side, the batter looks to flick but misses. Wided.
A slower one and fuller on off, this is stroked to covers.
Starts off with a nice delivery. It is on off and it shapes away a touch. The batter drops it towards the off side for one.
Aizaz Khan to bowl from the other end.

EDGY FOUR! Mustafa won't care. He steps down the track and Christie bowls it short. Rohan swings his bat but only manages an outside edge which goes down to the third man fence. Two boundaries to end the first over. Perfect start for UAE.
FOUR! Mustafa is off the mark in style! Starts from where he left off that day against Ireland. A half-volley on off, Mustafa creams it through covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Almost! Very full and on middle, Suri looks to flick again but it goes off the inner half towards short fine leg for one.
A couple! UAE are underway! Strays in line and bowls it on the pads, it is worked behind square on the leg side for two.
Another one on a length and around off, Suri is solid in defense.
Starts off with a good length ball on off, Suri keeps it out from the back foot.

We are back for the chase! The Hong Kong players make their way out to the middle. Rohan Mustafa and Chirag Suri are the openers for the hosts. The bowling will be opened by Kyle Christie. Here we go...
